conditions.require: Server-side PHIOS_D1_MAINTENANCE_MODE is READ_ONLY on every active same-D1 Pages execution surface.
Accepted successor source with root middleware covers every active request, including custom domain, canonical URL and historical deployment aliases.
RUNTIME_DB is guard-owned before nested handlers; actual deployed GET-write and mutation probes fail closed without durable writes.
Fresh metadata proves no non-Pages same-D1 active writer, or each is independently isolated.

passRule: All four conditions must be proven for the same maintenance interval. Unknown or inaccessible active alias = do not migrate.
historicalPagesAliasRequirement: Inventory and independently block every old same-D1 deployment URL or prove it cannot write; switching only the canonical Pages URL is insufficient. Any production operation requires separate authorization.
migrationChannel: Canonical Wrangler D1 migration tooling only; no HTTP bypass or app migration endpoint.
